title: Privileged flows threat evaluation + remediation runbook (RBAC v2 / audits / SSO)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Consolidate findings from the recent internal security review and third-party pen test into an actionable remediation runbook targeting privileged flows across RBAC v2, admin controls, SSO/SAML assertion handling, and audit/logging. Goals: (1) close high-risk admin impersonation and session fixation vectors; (2) improve audit fidelity and tamper-resistance for privileged operations; (3) ensure SAML assertion replay protection and audience/issuer validation across the private control plane; (4) produce a reproducible validation matrix and retest plan for the pen-test vendor and internal SOC. Scope: Platform control plane (admin console, rollout APIs, dedicated admin service endpoints), SSO integrations (SAML IdP flows used by enterprise customers), RBAC v2 policy enforcement paths (policy evaluation service, cached policy layers), audit pipeline ingestion and immutable log retention for privileged events. Out of scope for this ticket: data-plane model inference tokens and customer-facing user permissions unrelated to admin/privileged flows.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A runbook document exists mapping each pen-test finding to a remediation, owner, estimated effort, and test procedure.
2) Code changes for assertion validation and admin session binding are merged behind a feature flag in canary.
3) Audit log schema updated to include immutable event id and admin-session fingerprint; pipeline DAG updated to sign batches.
4) Re-run of selected pen-test cases shows resolved findings (report attached) or documented compensating controls.
5) Updated ops playbook and rollback steps added to the Console runbooks.
6) Security review sign-off recorded in Confluence and ticket closed.
updates: 2025-02-12: Created ticket after triage call with SecEng and Platform PM. Collected pen-test report (vendor: RedProbe) and prioritized 6 findings as P0/P1 for privileged flows.

2025-02-13: Threat modeling workshop held (Maya, Luca, Priya, Andre). Agreed on attack surfaces: admin session token, SAML assertion replay, RBAC policy cache poisoning, audit log tamperability. Outcome: map created in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/Privileged+Flows+Threat+Map.

2025-02-15: Spike PR opened to add audience and not-before checks to SAML assertion consumer (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4987). Passes unit tests; needs integration tests in staging.

2025-02-17: Prototype of admin-session fingerprinting implemented (service: admin-session-svc, branch: feature/session-fingerprint). Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/Admin+Session+Fingerprinting.

2025-02-18: Audit pipeline proposal posted: add deterministic event_id and HMAC signature per event batch. Discussed with infra (Tomas) and logs team (Nadia). Decision: use KMS-backed signing key rotated quarterly.
2025-02-19: Remediation tasks split into four sub-issues and owners assigned. Integration test checklist drafted. Pending: performance impact analysis for signing on high-throughput admin operations.
2025-02-20: Submitted request for pen-test vendor retest window (requested dates 2025-03-03 to 2025-03-07). SOC to review audit retention policy changes before deployment to prod.
next_steps: Finalize integration tests for SAML assertion checks and run against staging IdP.
Perform load bench on audit-signing patch to quantify latency; add async signer if >2% p95 token path delta.
Merge admin-session fingerprinting behind feature flag and enable for 10% canary on staging clusters.
Coordinate retest window with vendor and provide test cases + evidence artifacts for closed items.
Schedule 1-hour security sign-off meeting the week of 2025-03-02 to validate results and approve rollout plan.
review_notes: Trade-offs discussed: signing audit events synchronously increases end-to-end latency for some admin paths — decided to gate with rollout % and performance threshold; alternative is append-only S3 with envelope signing (higher storage cost). RBAC cache invalidation window shortened from 60s to 5s for admin policy churn scenarios to reduce risk of stale allow decisions; cost: higher policy evaluation QPS. SAML replay window tightened to 30s and nonce store persisted to Redis cluster with eviction. Need security team approval for KMS key policy changes.
done_criteria: All remediation PRs merged and feature-flagged, integration tests green in staging, vendor retest confirms closed findings or acceptable compensating controls, runbook and ops playbook updated, sign-off recorded in Confluence.
